name: Cain
title: The First Murderer
summary: Cain was the firstborn son of Adam and Eve and the first murderer in history. He was a farmer, and when God did not look with favor on his offering while accepting Abel's, Cain became jealous and killed his brother. God marked him and sent him away as a fugitive.

keyEvents.title: Birth
keyEvents.description: Eve gave birth to Cain and said, 'I have brought forth a man with the Lord's help.' He became a farmer.

keyEvents.title: The Offering
keyEvents.description: Cain brought an offering from the produce of the ground, but God did not look with favor on it, while he accepted Abel's offering.

keyEvents.title: God's Warning
keyEvents.description: God warned Cain that sin was crouching at the door, but he could rule over it.

keyEvents.title: The Murder of Abel
keyEvents.description: Cain lured Abel out into the field and killed him. When God asked where Abel was, Cain answered: 'Am I my brother's keeper?'

keyEvents.title: The Curse and the Mark
keyEvents.description: God cursed Cain to be a fugitive and a wanderer, but put a mark on him so that no one would kill him.
